title: Regulation of Chromatin Architecture by Transcription Factor Binding
authors: Stephanie Portillo-Ledesma; Suckwoo Chung; Jill Hoffman; Tamar Schlick
one_liner_zh: 该文用隐式建模方法模拟Myc:Max转录因子与染色质纤维DNA的结合，研究TF结合对染色质结构动态的调控机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构建模研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制分析。
abstract: Transcription factors (TF) bind to chromatin and regulate the expression of genes. The pair Myc:Max binds to E-box regulatory DNA elements throughout the genome, controlling transcription of a large group of specific genes. We introduce an implicit modeling protocol for Myc:Max binding to mesoscale chromatin fibers to determine TF effect on chromatin architecture and shed light on its mechanism of gene regulation. We first bind Myc:Max to different chromatin locations and show how it can direct fiber folding and formation of microdomains, and how this depends on the linker DNA length. Second, by simulating increasing concentrations of Myc:Max binding to fibers that differ in the DNA linker length, linker histone density, and acetylation levels, we assess the interplay between Myc:Max and other chromatin internal parameters. Third, we study the mechanism of gene silencing by Myc:Max binding to the Eed gene loci. Overall, our results show how chromatin architecture can be regulated by TF binding. The position of TF binding dictates the formation of microdomains that appear visible only at the ensemble level. On the other hand, the presence of linker histone, acetylations, or different linker DNA lengths regulates the concentration-dependent effect of TF binding. Furthermore, we show how TF binding can repress gene expression by increasing fiber folding motifs that help compact and occlude the promoter region. Importantly, this effect can be reversed by increasing linker histone density. Overall, these results shed light on the epigenetic control of the genome dictated by TF binding.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TF）与染色质结合并调控基因表达。Myc:Max 对结合于基因组中的E-box调控DNA元件，控制着一大组特定基因的转录。我们引入了一种隐式建模方案，用于Myc:Max 与中尺度染色质纤维的结合，以确定TF对染色质结构的影响，并揭示其基因调控机制。首先，我们将Myc:Max 结合到不同的染色质位置，展示其如何引导纤维折叠和微结构域的形成，以及这如何依赖于连接DNA长度。其次，通过模拟增加Myc:Max 浓度与在DNA连接长度、连接组蛋白密度和乙酰化水平上有所差异的纤维结合，我们评估了Myc:Max 与其他染色质内部参数之间的相互作用。第三，我们研究了Myc:Max 结合到Eed基因位点导致基因沉默的机制。总体而言，我们的结果显示了染色质结构如何受TF结合调控。TF结合的位置决定了微结构域的形成，而这些微结构域仅在整体水平上可见。另一方面，连接组蛋白的存在、乙酰化修饰或不同的连接DNA长度调节了TF结合的浓度依赖性效应。此外，我们展示了TF结合如何通过增加有助于压缩和遮蔽启动子区域的纤维折叠基序来抑制基因表达。重要的是，这种效应可以通过增加连接组蛋白密度来逆转。总体而言，这些结果揭示了由TF结合决定的基因组表观遗传调控机制。
